messages:
jess: FYI customer reports 403 when trying to edit Project settings in Console after they updated OAuth consent. They can view, but the edit buttons are greyed and API calls return 403 Permission Denied. Anyone seen this pattern after an idp consent/config change?
kevin: Do we have repro steps or logs? Is this via the console UI or using an API key/delegated token?
samir: +1 need exact repro. Also which role/claim the IdP sent previously vs now. Sometimes claim rename strips the project write scope.
jess: Repro steps from customer: 1) Login via SSO, 2) Navigate to Org > Projects > ProjectX > Settings, 3) Click Edit, 403 modal pops. They also ran curl to our projects API and saw: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "User lacks project:write for project:proj-xyz"
}
```
kevin: That response suggests the token doesn't include the delegated scope we expect (project:write) OR our role mapping lost the binding. Any recent SCIM/idp sync failures in audit?
support-bot: SCIM resync for acme-inc scheduled (run id: resync-2026-03-17T21:05Z). Last full sync: 2026-03-16T02:12Z.
samir: I checked audit logs for user j.smith@acme and see a role mapping change at 5967891180: claim `roles` -> `groups_v2` rename from the IdP. Our role mapping rule matched `roles` so after rename their `project-admin` binding dropped.
kevin: That explains it. Workarounds: 1) Have IdP revert claim rename, or 2) Update our mapping to accept `groups_v2` or add a temporary manual binding. Which does customer prefer?
jess: Customer asked for quick fix, they can't wait for their IdP team. They asked if we can manually reassign project-admin on their behalf.
oncall: I can do a temporary manual grant. Samir can you provide the minimal admin API call I can run?
samir: Use the admin role endpoint, example (replace ids):
```
POST /v1/orgs/org-123/projects/proj-xyz/roles
Authorization: Bearer <admin-api-key>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "principal_type": "user",
  "principal": "j.smith@acme",
  "role": "project-admin"
}
```
oncall: Running now...
(support-bot): deploy-bot posted: role-grant job queued (job id: grant-5967891238)
oncall: Done — API returned 200. Please ask the customer to retry.
jess: Customer reports they can edit now, buttons active, settings saved. They confirmed via console and API. :tada:
kevin: We'll also push a mapping rule update so new claim name doesn't break others. Samir, can you add `groups_v2` to the mapping and schedule a SCIM resync?
samir: Will do. Plan: 1) Update mapping to OR on `roles` || `groups_v2`, 2) Run a targeted SCIM sync for acme-inc, 3) Postmortem with customer and IdP. ETA for mapping & resync: 2 hours.
jess: Noted, I've told the customer the manual grant is temporary and we'll follow up after permanent fix.
kevin: Adding note: also check any service tokens tied to delegated scopes; they may need re-issuance if claim rename happened during token mint.
jess: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread once mapping update confirmed.
support-bot: mapping-change job scheduled (job id: mapping-5967891250).
